role: Secular writer, blogger, and science communicator
contribution: Avijit Roy was a Bangladeshi-American writer, blogger, and science communicator whose Mukto-Mona platform influenced secular and rationalist discussion in Bangladesh and the Shahbag-era public sphere.
context: He was killed in Dhaka on 26 February 2015 while returning from the Ekushey Book Fair with his wife, who was injured. The attack followed years of public conflict over religious criticism, free expression, and the safety of secular writers.
impact: Roy's killing became an international symbol of the danger faced by writers who challenge religious extremism. His work and the response to his death remain part of debates about intellectual freedom, violence, and accountability in Bangladesh.
highlight: Mukto-Mona founder and secular writer killed after the 2015 Ekushey Book Fair.
seoTitle: Avijit Roy: Secular Writer and Mukto-Mona Founder
seoDescription: Learn about Avijit Roy, the Bangladeshi-American writer and science communicator whose 2015 killing became a global free-expression case.
shortAnswer: Avijit Roy was a Bangladeshi-American writer and Mukto-Mona founder killed in Dhaka on 26 February 2015.

faq.question: Who was Avijit Roy?
faq.answer: He was a Bangladeshi-American writer, blogger, and science communicator who founded Mukto-Mona and was killed in Dhaka in February 2015.
